name: MrLTTec Home
subtitle: Control the TVs, speakers and lights on any Wi-Fi.
localizedDescription: The MrLTTec Smart Home Tool, now on your iPhone. Join any Wi-Fi, tap Discover, and control what is on that network: Sonos speakers, Roku, Samsung TVs, Wemo plugs, WLED strips, WiZ lights and outlets, and turning on an Xbox. Includes network tools: list every device, ping, and check ports. No PC, server or internet needed.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Finds and controls the TVs, speakers and lights on the Wi-Fi you are connected to.
